what_works: Tabular directory layout with row-aligned thumbnails and metadata columns — feels like a database UI in the best way. For a tech-curious younger trade owner, this 'we run a tight operation' signal is exactly the right move.
what_does_not_translate: The pure directory format flattens emotion — combine with one warmer hero section above so the page doesn't feel transactional.
type_observations: Grotesk display + monospace for row metadata; tight line heights, generous column gutters — the rhythm is spreadsheet, not magazine.
